sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Curve information and native-parameter evaluation for line, circle/arc and NURBS: kind, domain, NURBS degree/poles/periodic/reversed, D0-D3 samples in object-local millimetres bounded to 1024 samples. The owner's evaluation::evaluate_curve is reused; polycurve needs an explicit segment parameter and is refused. Reading/evaluating stages no mutation.
